source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The rename changes the exported binding to InputSanitizer, installs InputSanitizer.sys.mjs, and updates direct/lazy consumers and dynamic test calls together. Exact byte comparison proves the moved module implementation changes only its export name; the fixed accepted module retains those bytes. Method calls keep the validator object as receiver. This establishes the component's resource/binding migration, not a global name ban, stronger validation or runtime compatibility result.
title: Account creation renames its validator export and resource together
